text_block_list.text: I was practicing dance lessons with Mejiro Dober, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sorry... do you mind if I turn off the music?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...You can tell, right?
That I'm not dancing properly at all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It just feels like
I'm not dancing the way I want at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to give back to the fans who support me, even just a little...
but with dancing like this――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to give back to the fans who support me, even just a little...
but with dancing like this――
Are you really sure about that!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: !? P-Pearl-san!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow away such very small worries
in no time!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's go dancing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's... You want me to do that dance!?
M-Me...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Of course! C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Pearl-san's dancing is
so magnificent, glamorous, and...
I think it's truly captivating!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Still... none of those are things
I have, so..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even if I dance, it doesn't really go well...
I feel like I wouldn't be able to convey anything at all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That might be true—
but then again, it might not.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Our performance will ride the airwaves,
reaching living rooms all across Japan, the other side of the globe... and even the far reaches of space...!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I find it hard to believe that anyone receiving it wouldn't feel a single thing...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just as you called my dancing perfect,
perhaps someone might say the same
about your dancing, too...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Because the possibilities are endless! Which means we should look at everything positively!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"......In a good way......
My dance could...... reach someone too......"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Pearl-san.
I'm gonna try pushing myself a little harder.

After that, perhaps believing in the possibilities,
Mejiro Dober became able to dance with a sharpness
unlike anything she had shown before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for today.
I don't even know how to thank you...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No need to thank me. If you still wish to give thanks,
then direct it to those you want to convey your feelings to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
People I want to share my feelings with... huh.
...There are so many, it's hard to choose.
choice_data_list: Let's tackle what we can see first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Field of view............

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
J-Just so you know!
I don't mean for you or anything like that, okay...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Then first of all, I need to make sure...
a certain someone closest to me gets the message!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then I'll keep going...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then I'll keep going...!

Afterward, Mejiro Dober continued
her dance lessons, but...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Dober-senpai is dancing.
Dignified, powerful... and so cool...!

And so, Mejiro Dober steadily polished
her dance meant to convey her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My dancing... throughout the whole world...
Becoming famous......

text_block_list.name: Foreign Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Kyaaaa! Doberrr!
Look over hereee! Dance for us~~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-Impossible!!
There's no way that can be done...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...A-As expected, that might be too embarrassing.
I really don't think I can do that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I mean by impossible!
I'm talking about it more mentally...!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Gotta train our mental fortitude too!
Yeah. We need to train our mental fortitude too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I appreciate the thought,
but I was talking about something mental, you know...?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Gotta train our mental fortitude too!
Yeah. We need to train our mental fortitude too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sheesh... What do I have to say to make you understand?
Look, what I'm saying is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That is indeed how it is—... No...
...Is that really... how it is...?
After that, Mejiro Dober finally gave in and continued her dance lessons, steadily polishing the precision of her routine.
